sentences.text: Read every note printed on a chart before you navigate with it.
Notes explain regulations, cautions about shoaling or unreliable aids, and datum information.
On electronic charts you’ll see two kinds.
Raster charts are scanned images of paper charts and look just like them.
Electronic navigational charts, or E N Cs, are vector data that the plotter draws.
They’re powerful, but soundings and hazards can disappear when you zoom out, so always zoom in to check your route.
Whatever kind of chart you use, make sure it’s the most current edition.
